svg.aria-label: Finite-grid connectivity simulation with a fixed set of candidate links; blue marks the largest cluster. Equal-mass nodes illustrate connectivity rather than an experimental gel-fraction measurement. The historical note connects to Flory and Stockmayer’s gelation work.
